instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: The investigation leads us to Brazil. A drought was happening there. People had also stopped hoping that the next harvest would be better. Will there be enough beans? Before we think about how to brew them, we must ask if there will be any beans to brew at all. We turned the pages of the record and find this: In February, before summer, New York's Arabica coffee futures price reached a record high. This was not the price of ground coffee in stores. It was the market price for trading coffee beans. The market alarm had already sounded. So, were tariffs not to blame? No, that would be deciding too soon, too. Reuters also reported that U.S. tariffs put in place during summer raised the price of the beans themselves. They did play a part, but we must put events in the right order.
